blurb: Guests cruise the crystal-clear waters of the Emerald Coast on private boats for dolphin watching, sunset views, dining, and special celebrations. The experience is personalized around the occasion with options for music, sightseeing, relaxation, and private events. Boats are equipped with safety gear, bathrooms, kitchenettes, grills, fresh water, and TVs.
